measurement.method: single-image manual visual measurement from canonical target only; bounds estimated to outer visible edges of major first-level regions in native pixels
measurement.precision: integer pixel bounds for regions; normalized values rounded to 6 decimals; fine frame protrusions, glows and shadows excluded unless they define the visible panel edge

regions.label: news list navigation header
internalStructure: full-width dark textured header inside the shared outer metal shell
large square back control at left
centered gold page title
symmetric horizontal title flourishes with small diamond ornaments
alignment: page title centered on the canvas horizontal axis
back control vertically centered within the header band
title flourishes extend symmetrically to both sides of the title
spacing: ~20 px from header frame left edge to back control
back control occupies roughly 91 x 79 px
~14 px inset from canvas top to visible header frame
header bottom meets the summary region at y~143
notes: no system status bar, WeChat capsule or product tab bar is drawn
small circular marks near the upper-right area appear decorative rather than a resolved control

regions.label: result summary and subscription action
internalStructure: left-aligned large summary heading
smaller article-count line below the heading
right-aligned outlined subscription/filter action with a cycle-arrow icon
alignment: heading and count share a left text rail near x~58
action button aligns to the right internal rail near x~806
left text block and right action are vertically balanced within the region
spacing: ~41 px left inset to heading
~14 px vertical gap between heading and count line
~41 px right inset from shared shell to action button
notes: region has no independent enclosing card; it sits between the header divider and category frame
visible title and count are target copy only and do not assert runtime data

regions.label: news category tabs and filter control
internalStructure: single ornate horizontal frame
six text category tabs
selected first tab inside an inset metal plate with a gold underline
sliders-style filter icon at far right
alignment: tabs arranged in one horizontal row
all labels vertically centered
selected tab plate aligns to the frame's inner top and bottom rails
filter glyph occupies a fixed far-right slot
spacing: ~17 px inner horizontal inset from frame to selected plate
tab labels use broadly even visual spacing across the available row
~24 px gap from filter-frame bottom to the first news card
notes: selected state is communicated by brighter ivory text, enclosed plate and short gold underline
the target alone does not define tab hit-box boundaries

regions.label: six visible news result cards
internalStructure: six vertically stacked framed news cards
each card has a narrow blue or gold left accent rail
each card has a left document medallion
each card has one title and two metadata/status chips
each card has a right chevron above or beside a relative-time label
alignment: all cards share common left and right edges
document medallions form one vertical column
titles and chips share fixed left rails across all six cards
timestamps and chevrons align to a common right-side column
spacing: card heights are approximately 146-148 px
vertical gaps between cards are approximately 10-12 px
~25 px from card left edge to document medallion
~23 px from medallion right edge to title column
chips are arranged horizontally with approximately 17 px between them
notes: visible status pattern is four pending-review chips and two translated chips
visible accent pattern is blue, blue, gold, blue, gold, gold from top to bottom
repeated titles, statuses and relative times are target placeholders rather than runtime truth

regions.label: empty result state panel
internalStructure: large framed dark panel
centered circular no-entry emblem with small radial ornaments
centered empty-state heading
centered supporting sentence
centered outlined retry button
alignment: all content centered on the panel horizontal axis
emblem, heading, supporting text and button form one vertical stack
retry button centered below the supporting sentence
spacing: ~45 px from panel top to emblem
~17 px from emblem to heading
~16 px from heading to supporting text
~27 px from supporting text to retry button
notes: the target visibly shows this panel after six populated rows; this is an inventory fact, not a claim that both runtime states coexist
outer panel shadow is excluded from bounds

regions.label: bottom reference disclaimer bar
internalStructure: full-width inset metal footer band
small shield icon
single centered disclaimer line with middle-dot separator
small circular fastener ornaments near both sides
alignment: shield and disclaimer text form one horizontally centered group
footer content vertically centered within the band
side fasteners are approximately symmetric
spacing: ~10 px gap from empty-state panel to footer band
~18 px between shield icon and disclaimer text
~12 px decorative shell remainder below the footer
notes: footer is a reference warning, not a product tab bar
the visible disclaimer is target copy and not an assertion about source authority

globalAlignment: the outer decorative shell spans nearly the full 864 px canvas with visible rails around x~5-859
top bar, summary and disclaimer use a wider inner rail near x~15-17
category and empty-state frames share a narrower rail near x~31-833
news cards share the narrowest content rail near x~35-831
the composition is a single vertical flow: top bar -> summary -> category filter -> six-card list -> empty state -> disclaimer
globalSpacing: top bar and summary meet at y~143
summary and category frame meet at y~291
category frame to first card gap ~24 px
news list to empty-state panel gap ~16 px
empty-state panel to disclaimer gap ~10 px
disclaimer to canvas bottom decorative remainder ~12 px
unresolved: exact outer bounds of thin shadows, inner highlights and frame protrusions may vary by 1-3 px
fine glyph baselines, authored letter spacing and font metrics were not measured at subpixel level
the small circular mark near the header's upper-right area is not semantically resolvable beyond likely decoration
the exact hit-box widths of the six category labels and far-right filter glyph cannot be determined from a static target
micro-details inside document, source, pending, translated, shield and no-entry icons are not pixel-certain
the simultaneous visibility of populated rows and the empty-state panel is recorded as target composition only, not runtime state truth
